description: This file contains extension methods for configuring dependency injection within the Orleans project, specifically adding or trying to add existing service registrations to an IServiceCollection.

classes.name: ServiceCollectionExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods for IServiceCollection to facilitate registration of existing service implementations.

methods.name: AddFromExisting
methods.description: Registers an existing implementation of a service type as a provider for that service, based on type parameters.

methods.name: AddFromExisting (overload)
methods.description: Registers an existing implementation type for a service type, by locating a previous registration and creating a new one that delegates to it.

methods.name: TryAddFromExisting
methods.description: Attempts to register an existing implementation for a service type only if no such registration exists yet.
